sequence.description: Country road narrows into merge lane

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Bradley, are you sure this is the right—

sequence.speaker: gps
sequence.text: In 500 meters, take the third exit.

sequence.description: Full roundabout comes into view - impossibly large

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: I think that was a merge lane.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: There's a lot of cars in here.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: That was our exit!

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: There'll be another one.

dialogue.speaker: gps
dialogue.text: Recalculating.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Is that... is that the same van?

sequence.description: 1987 Wedding Van comes into clear view

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: That sign says 1987.

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: That was thirty-seven years ago.

sequence.description: Skeleton visible in passenger seat. Driver waves cheerfully.

dialogue.speaker: patrick_osullivan_01
dialogue.text: First time?

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: We're trying to find the exit to—

dialogue.speaker: patrick_osullivan_01
dialogue.text: Doesn't matter. They all lead back here eventually.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: Is that tour bus growing vegetables on the roof?

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: 'Democratic Since 2013'?

dialogue.speaker: orla_brennan_tour_leader_01
dialogue.text: Welcome! Are you here for the orientation?

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Please. We've been circling for hours. Is there ANY way out?

dialogue.speaker: sean_murphy_exit_01
dialogue.text: Exit 6. North. Leads straight to the Cliffs.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: WHAT? You KNEW this whole time?!

dialogue.speaker: sean_murphy_exit_01
dialogue.text: Of course. I've known since '99.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Then why don't you LEAVE?!

dialogue.speaker: sean_murphy_exit_01
dialogue.text: Out there... anything could happen.

sequence.description: Seán drives past Exit 6 without changing speed.

dialogue.speaker: sean_murphy_exit_01
dialogue.text: In here, I know what comes next. Another circle. Then another.

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: That's... the most horrifying thing I've ever heard.

dialogue.speaker: sean_murphy_exit_01
dialogue.text: Is it though? Think about it tonight. When you're trying to sleep.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: ...Is the GPS crying?

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: I think we broke it.

dialogue_after.speaker: bradley
dialogue_after.text: On purpose. He drove past it on purpose.

dialogue_after.speaker: chadwick
dialogue_after.text: We drove in a circle. A massive, hour-long circle.

triggers.description: Bros slow down due to food truck, traffic, or accident

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: Wait... we're moving slower and... I can actually read the signs.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: That's Exit 6. North. The Cliffs.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: We're actually going somewhere!

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: Did we just... leave?

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: I think we did. I think we actually did.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: ...Should we go back for the others?

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: They've made their choices.

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: The roundabout provides.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Don't. Don't say that. Don't become one of them.

dialogue_samples.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue_samples.text: We just need to try HARDER.

dialogue_samples.speaker: chadwick
dialogue_samples.text: I'm hungry. Is that a food truck?

dialogue.speaker: tour_bus_passenger
dialogue.text: How old are you, son? You look stressed.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: What? I'm not stressed. I'm thirty-ni— ...twenty-nine. I'm twenty-nine.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: You were thirty-nine like three months ago at your birthd—

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: I'M TWENTY-NINE, CHADWICK.

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: The math doesn't—

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: THE MATH IS FINE.

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: You know, the roundabout is actually a perfect metaphor for life. We're all just circling, looking for our exit, but we don't know which one to take. And the GPS of society keeps recalculating, but it never really knows either. We're all just... circling. Forever. Until we're not.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Brad, you good?

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: I think the roundabout is changing me.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: Should I film this breakdown?

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: Yes. This is content.

bradley_girlfriend.description: Bradley meets a woman on the tour bus who shares his philosophical outlook

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: You know... it's not so bad here.

dialogue.speaker: chadwick
dialogue.text: The content potential is unlimited.

dialogue.speaker: bradley
dialogue.text: And there's no pressure. No expectations. Just... the circle.

dialogue.speaker: lord_pilsner
dialogue.text: Should we... stay?

path_b_exit.description: Even on Path B, bros eventually leave, but with deeper understanding

sequence.speaker: documentary_narrator
sequence.text: The Cloverleaf: once a traffic nightmare, now Publandia's most philosophical tourist destination.

sequence.description: Gift shop now open, tour buses arriving intentionally

sequence.speaker: patrick_osullivan_01
dialogue: People come from all over now. To circle. To think. To find what they're looking for.
Most of them are looking for the exit.
Margaret and I? We found what we were looking for years ago.

sequence.description: Margaret, still 'resting' in the passenger seat
A new van enters - 'JUST MARRIED 2024' in shoe polish
The couple inside waves nervously. Patrick waves back, knowingly.

sequence.speaker: patrick_osullivan_01
sequence.text: First time? ...That's what they all say.
